info.title: SSL & Server Location
info.details: SSL enables secure HTTPS connections (vital for trust and SEO), while server location impacts loading speed for visitors in specific regions.

learn_more.description: Consider these for security and performance:
benefits: SSL Certificate: Essential for HTTPS (the padlock icon in browsers). Encrypts data between your site and visitors, crucial for security, trust, and SEO. Most hosts offer free Let's Encrypt SSL certificates that should auto-renew.
Server Location: Choosing a data center physically closer to your target audience reduces latency (the time it takes for data to travel), resulting in faster page load times for those visitors.

CDN (Content Delivery Network): For a global audience, a CDN complements server location by caching your site's content on servers worldwide, delivering it from the closest point to each visitor. Some hosts offer integrated CDNs.
